CVE-2026-132857.title: flac: flac: stack buffer overflow in the flac CLI via crafted metadata blocks and --picture options
CVE-2026-132857.description: A flaw was found in the flac command-line encoder. When re-encoding a specially crafted FLAC file carrying a very large number of metadata blocks, supplying multiple --picture options causes the encoder to write past the end of a fixed-size buffer on the stack, corrupting its internal state and crashing the process. This issue can be triggered only when a user runs the flac command-line tool with --picture options on an untrusted input file; the demonstrated impact is a crash of the encoding process.
